goal: Prevent debug assertion crashes when an orphan already in the mempool is processed in a package
Ensure orphan state cleans up properly when transactions enter the mempool through non-peer pathways
agreement: Suggested proactive cleanup on mempool entry instead of reactive package evaluation (ismaelsadeeq)
Verified by testing on Windows without substantive rationale (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it addresses an edge-case debug assertion crash during package evaluation
The condition requires an orphan to enter the mempool through non-peer paths like RPC
